title: 90-minute Thai and Bali relaxing massage
text:
This time I had the massage with Mint, and as always, it was wonderful. 
You leave there feeling completely new; they know what they are doing, where to touch, and how to do it to heal without pain.

author: ediviagalan

title: Best Massage Experience
text: I had a Balinese and Thai massage, and it was an amazing experience. Rizza was absolutely fantastic. I had a stiff neck and pain in my neck and back before the massage, but after the session I could actually turn my neck comfortably again. She was professional, skilled, and made me feel completely relaxed. I’m extremely satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend Rizza to anyone looking for a high-quality massage. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

title: Thai Spa Massage is a wonderful experience!
text: A massage is always one of life's pleasures! This was no exception. The massage was wonderful! Location is very clean and the staff are pleasant and try to be helpful as they can. Temperature in the room was comfortable and the sensation of good strong hands pulling, kneading and massaging my muscles felt incredible! The location is perfect if you are looking for something right inside Barcelona.
